randomization_rule: Sort task IDs by ascending SHA256(random_seed + id). First two get baseline first, remaining task gets guided_mcp first. Both clones of each task receive byte-identical code and fixed failing regression test.

intervention.treatment: One real godprompt.get_tailored_guidance invocation, task_type=DEBUG, phase=execute, compact=true, max_chars=600, completed BEFORE first source edit; no other GodPrompt or MCP calls.
intervention.baseline: No active MCP servers or GodPrompt prompt/skills. Same task context, tests, code and permission profile.
intervention.note: Treatment text is a short general process guide, not independently verified source-specific diagnosis; compare combined tool-invocation policy, not isolated model reasoning.

No independent blinded human reviewer; two correct patch references are same-researcher authored, not independent adjudication.
Treatment invokes the actual GodPrompt tool once before editing. The compact text is generic; this evaluates the joint call-and-instruction policy.
Only three paired tasks, one first run per arm; sampling noise, prompt differences and order effects prevent population causal claims.
